-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	fabrikweb "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"
)

//fabrik:web:notfound
func BadSig() {}

//fabrik:web:notfound
var notAFunc int

//fabrik:web:methodnotallowed
func RawSig(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}

//fabrik:web:methodnotallowed
func Generic[T any](req *fabrikweb.Request) (fabrikweb.Response, error) {
	return fabrikweb.Status(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed), nil
}
